key_facts: Maya is a teenager wearing a soaked marching-band jacket
She asks the station to announce a missing dog named Comet
She says Comet stole her grilled cheese and slept through the evacuation
She spells Comet's name for the broadcast
She later finds Comet under the vending machine in the band room
She brings the muddy, sleepy Comet to the radio studio in the morning
